For the special participation A on HW0, I use Grok to address the non-coding analytical components (problems 2–5). The performance of Grok really impressed me, almost all questions are one-shot correct except for 5(b)(iii).

Summary: Grok demonstrated reliable analytical reasoning for most problems, with clear and accurate derivations for problems 2, 3, and 4. The answer of them are all fully correct. However, the error on problem 5(b)(iii) suggests its sensitivity to complex or ambiguous problem structures. 

Here is the link https://grok.com/share/c2hhcmQtMg%3D%3D_935edffc-4c41-4eb5-931a-aaf30ccdf737
